text:
Ava: quick follow-up to the gateway retry/streaming discussion. proposing a tiny header 'x-ci-purpose: streaming|single' so edge can pick connection strategy early. sketching tradeoffs below.

Tom: is this header advisory or will the gateway enforce different scheduling/slots?

Ava: default advisory. tenants can opt into an enforcement flag where streaming purpose forces a pinned connection with a slightly larger KV prefetch window. no change to current behavior unless enabled.

Rina: how should trailers factor? e.g., upstream trailer says 'expect-more=1' after initial frames. do we upgrade intent midstream?

Ava: plan: trailers are weak signals. gateway MAY transition single->stream on seeing an expect-more trailer but we DO NOT downgrade stream->single midstream. downgrade would break client assumptions.

Leo: concern: clients could game it by issuing many single calls and switching to stream to hold resources. mitigation?

Tom: rate-limit upgrades per tenant and require an upgrade handshake token issued by runtime when it acknowledges streaming capability. also track upgrade counters in policy layer.

Rina: runtime implications: conn states: transient, reserved, reserved-upgraded. transient = short-lived; reserved = pinned; reserved-upgraded = pinned via midstream upgrade. need metrics and TTLs.

Ava: infra checklist: add intent header to ingress logs, log trailer hints, ETM counters for upgrades attempted/succeeded/rejected, admission config knob maxReservedPerTenant, and backpressure fallback to hedged single-paths when reserved pool is saturated.

Leo: small header/example:
GET /v1/chat
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-ci-purpose: streaming;v=1
trailer: expect-more=1;prefetch-window=32

Tom: retry behavior note: if reserved-upgraded connection fails, prefer stateless model-variant fallback (same path) instead of retrying reserved pool. that avoids long reallocation cycles.

Ava: agreed. fallback order: compatible model-variant on same route -> hedged single-path replicas -> fail. documentable per-tenant.

bot-deploy: feature flag staged: intent-header + upgrade-guard enabled on staging. 3790000001 by @Ava

Rina: I'll add the conn-state enum to runtime PR and wire counters. unit tests: simulate upgrade, kill upstream, assert variant fallback used.

Ava: let's meet tomorrow 11am to pick sane defaults for maxReservedPerTenant and upgrade-rate-limits. I'll drop a short agenda.

Tom: +1. I'll produce a rough abuse-threshold proposal.

Leo: +1. I'll run a quick microbench comparing reserved vs transient throughput and tail latency.
